agent_explanation: Two heavy bodies undergo a close encounter (distance 0.81 at step 37 -> 0.64 at step 38 -> 0.48 at step 39). Softened gravity gives very large accelerations/velocities (body 1 speed ~15.9 at step 39, kinetic ~2304 vs initial ~866). Adaptive substeps grow only 12->13->14 per outer step, insufficient to resolve the steep potential well at dt~0.013, so leapfrog integration loses energy monotonically (520.9->481.3->408.7) and breaches energy_conserved at step 39. Reducing dt to 0.001 eliminates the drift, confirming temporal-resolution failure, not a force-model error (momentum stays conserved).
